description: This file contains Pydantic model definitions for a DataPlaneService related to Frame specification, encapsulation, reassembly, status, and telemetry. It defines data schemas used for validation, data interchange, and API documentation within a satellite link data plane project.

classes.name: FSOHeader
classes.description: Model for the header of an FSO frame segment, including version, sequence, total segments, payload length, CRC, FEC scheme, ARQ enable flag, and timestamp.

classes.name: EncapsulatedSegment
classes.description: Represents a single encapsulated segment with header and payload in hex format, includes a validator to ensure payload is valid hex.

classes.name: EncapsulationRequest
classes.description: Request model to encapsulate Ethernet frames into FSO segments with parameters.

classes.name: EncapsulationResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the generated segments, total bytes, and segment count.

classes.name: ReassemblyRequest
classes.description: Request model to reassemble Ethernet frame from received segments.

classes.name: ReassemblyResponse
classes.description: Response model with reassembled Ethernet frame (hex), missing segments, and status.

classes.name: BufferStatus
classes.description: Telemetry/status model for queues and reassembly sessions.

classes.name: ThroughputLatencyStats
classes.description: Model for reporting throughput and latency statistics.

classes.name: TelemetryOverview
classes.description: Summary telemetry including errors, corrections, retransmissions, and metadata.
